Because, again, we also need to have... the locals, the trail travelers, the local hosts, the trail parents; this kind of regional federalization is absolutely vital. We at Tășuleasa Social won’t be able to coordinate thousands of kilometers of tourism infrastructure indefinitely. We’re looking at northern Moldavia, in Botoșani, and again, people don’t expect it to be a tourist area, but it is one of the most magnificent regions. I left my heart there. In a single visit, I learned more about Botoșani County from this perspective than I did in the four months I spent doing my military service there. I probably just didn’t have eyes for it back then. But now, coming prepared for this journey, I had a really beautiful surprise. What matters to us is that when someone takes a step in Putna, or at any starting point on Via Transilvanica, a loaf of bread gets baked 1,000 kilometers away. We don’t want to create endless kilometers of trails, on the one hand, and on the other, we have to make everything sustainable. There’s no point in simply creating trails. Trails are being built; almost every region wants to have its own path now. What matters to us is that when someone takes a step in Putna, or at any starting point on Via Transilvanica, a loaf of bread gets baked 1,000 kilometers away. Essentially, what we’re interested in is creating this social circuit so needed in our region. The hoursing module in Șapartoc, Mureș County, which opened earlier this year  Photo: Tășuleasa Social Could you elaborate a bit on the notion of federalization? ‘Federalization’ may sound like a political manifesto, but I’m absolutely convinced that the future of major projects lies in every region bringing its best version to the table. For someone from Bistrița-Năsăud, as we are at Tășuleasa Social, to coordinate all of the tourism infrastructure is impossible. We don’t even want that. My culture in Bistrița-Năsăud is a particular one, specific to the place I come from. Things are done differently in Oltenia or Moldova. And in terms of the number of people, the people working for this ambassador [e.n. Via Transilvanica], there needs to be a permanent local presence on the ground, rather than us representing it from the center, so to speak. Everything needs coordination; everything needs to fall under the same brand or identity - although I think “brand” sounds a little more complex. Everyone needs to make their own polenta, because every ethnic group, every village is unique, yet it forms part of a region; the region is part of a historical province; and these historical provinces make up this fascinating Romania. That is what federalization means to us. There’s a social dimension to Via Transilvanica as it supports communities along the path. How did you see this reflected in the journey you undertook on Via Transilvanica last year? Romania’s rural area has been neglected because it lacked a social contract. From what we could tell, probably the last one was established with Queen Marie through the agrarian reform, through the way she interacted with the inhabitants of rural areas, the way she gave them visibility and genuine representation. Since this social contract is currently missing, also because neither statesmen nor Parliament, and sometimes not even the local representatives themselves, represent them as they should – you cannot run a locality if you don’t also love it, and if you love it, you know it – the people along Via Transilvanica began to believe in things that are good for them. This "doing good" has many nuances, because even a villain thinks he is doing good for his locality or for the forest he clear-cuts, as long as it gets turned into timber. I don't want to dwell on this, but in the 26 years since we started Tășuleasa, our vision has been that every individual can change the place where they live for the better. And the sum of these places makes up a country. This process of doing good needs to be carefully designed so that we can see what works. From this point of view, we have the Tășuleasa campus, where we essentially develop all our projects. As long as we have a deep understanding of what is happening and see that something is working well, we go back and say, “This works. Let’s see how we can scale it up.” That is precisely why Via Transilvanica works regardless of the region. You wouldn’t say that it works better in Oltenia or that it works better in Bucovina. Because it works equally well everywhere. Why? Because there are these ingredients that we have discovered: having rules, appreciation and appreciating others, having the freedom to act, and having trust. Once this appreciation begins, it leads to trust. This process of trust leads to action. And the actions are very simple. Entrepreneurship, for example: a woman living alone, in a very disadvantaged area, whose children have left and she is alone in old age. Suddenly, hikers start passing by her door, and if she brings some cherries from the cherry tree in her backyard, she becomes an entrepreneur. Essentially, a commercial exchange takes place. So, for us, the social circuit is the project of Tășuleasa Social and less the tourist project Via Transilvania. We were happy that it turned out to be a tourism project, but I think many researchers set out to create one thing and ended up with something else that became far more famous. A Via Transilvanica landmark placed on Șimian Island   Photo: Andrei Moldovan/ Tășuleasa Social Via Transilvanica has been named this year a trail of national interest. How has this helped so far? There is a very vehement reaction whenever we take a photo with a minister or with any politician. We have a community of sincere fans warning us we’ll pay the price if we get involved in politics. ‘Watch out because that's an unimaginable boogeyman.’ Given the fairly constant disappointment that politicians and political decision-makers have delivered, this is understandable. Yet Via Transilvanica does not run through Alin Ușeriu's private backyard. What I, as the founder of the Tășuleasa Social organization, was able to do is ensure that one of the core principles upon which the organization was built is not to use public funds, and to remain critical, constructively critical, whenever we build a project. But we still need to have a relationship with the authorities, because I can't personally go to a shepherd to take away his dogs. Animal welfare enforcement has to do that. For that, we need an institution to represent that authority. Tășuleasa Social, with just Via Transilvanica, wasn't enough. Now, Tășuleasa Social has carried out a project and manages Via Transilvanica, a trail of national interest and the first officially certified long-distance trail in Romania. It has become an institution with equal standing to any other institution in Romania: the mayor's offices, animal welfare enforcement, the Ministry of Agriculture. It is a mechanism that should be understood, because if we are constantly stuck between opposite extremes - we make the laws and don't care about those who criticize us - then we get to a place where, after 36 years and a bit more, we haven’t achieved very many positive results from this perspective of cooperation. This interview has been conducted in Romanian and translated by Romania Insider.

data.title: Rare photographs by Constantin Brâncuși to go on display in Romania’s Târgu Jiu
data.description: An exhibition featuring 33 rare photographs taken by Romanian sculptor Constantin Brâncuși will open at Pavilion Art 360 in Târgu Jiu on October 22. Titled Brâncuși. Photography. The Invisible Studio , it will remain open until December 16. Presented in Târgu Jiu for the first time, the photographs come from the collection of British collector David Grob, considered one of the leading private collections of Brâncuși photography. Grob is expected to attend the opening. Constantin Brâncuși photographed his own sculptures and studio and developed the images in a darkroom built inside his workspace on Impasse Ronsin in Paris. The exhibition includes self-portraits, photographs of sculptures, studio scenes, and still lifes, alongside films made in the artist’s studio. Visitors will also see early images of the Endless Column installed at Voulangis near Paris, as well as photographs taken by Brâncuși in Târgu Jiu of the column and the monumental ensemble created there in 1937-1938. “These photographs were long regarded as mere footnotes to his sculpture,” said exhibition curator and art historian Eduard Enache. “Today, we read them as the language through which Brâncuși speaks to us about his own work; I would even say that they are the studio itself, continued in another medium.” Enache said the Grob collection was particularly significant because it began taking shape in the 1970s, before Constantin Brâncuși’s photographs were widely regarded as artworks in their own right. “Some of these images were taken in Târgu Jiu and are now returning here after almost 90 years, to the place where the thinking of the studio left the enclosed space and met the sky,” he added. The exhibition is curated by Eduard Enache, with Brâncuși scholar Doina Lemny serving as scientific consultant. Its opening will precede the UNESCO-patronised international conference The Philosophy of Form, which will bring Constantin Brâncuși specialists from around the world to Târgu Jiu for four days. The exhibition will be open at Pavilion Art 360 from Monday to Friday between 09:00 and 17:00.

data.title: US congressman requests probe into ambassador’s claims about fall of Romanian government
data.description: Gregory Meeks, the leading Democrat on the US House Foreign Affairs Committee, officially requested on September 30 that the State Department, led by secretary Marco Rubio, confirm whether the US government was involved in the fall of the Ilie Bolojan government in Romania. The congressman's letter is only the latest episode in the scandal surrounding US ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle , who allegedly stated at a March dinner with the Greek energy minister in Athens that the United States had been involved in the dismissal of the Ilie Bolojan government. The US ambassador is now accused of using Christos Marafatsos, a registered lobbyist for the Greek construction and energy group Aktor Group, as a chief of staff during high-level official meetings. Aktor allegedly paid Marafatsos USD 160,000 through June 2026 to facilitate connections with the State Department, the Department of Energy, and the White House. Together, Marafatsos and Guilfoyle allegedly conducted diplomatic visits and applied commercial pressure in the Balkans. They promoted Aktor’s interests in discussions with Bulgaria’s president and prime minister concerning the Vertical Gas Corridor, brokered a USD 6 billion LNG agreement between US companies and Aktor LNG following a talk with Albanian PM Edi Rama, and pressured Romanian and Greek public officials. Meeks officially asked whether the Wall Street Journal report on Guilfoyle was true and whether the ambassador knew anything concrete about US involvement in the fall of the Bolojan government. He also asked whether the State Department, the White House, the National Security Council, or any other US institution had authorized or coordinated activities intended to influence the composition or survival of the Romanian government. In addition, Democratic congressman Meeks explicitly requested internal documents from the State Department and the US Embassy in Athens concerning Guilfoyle’s trips to Romania, her relationship with Marafatsos, and the March conversation about the Romanian government. The State Department was given a deadline of October 15, 2026, to provide the Committee with all records, emails, and diplomatic notes from September 2025 to the present. These include ethics recommendations received by the ambassador, details concerning private jet flights, and all notes relating to the March 2026 conversation about the governments of Romania and Greece. Guilfoyle met Romanian Social Democratic leader Sorin Grindeanu, energy minister Bogdan Ivan, and presidential adviser Bogdan Vlădică in Bucharest on March 31, roughly a month before the fall of the Liberal-led Bolojan government . However, Sorin Grindeanu and George Simion, the leader of the extremist AUR party and the authors of the motion of no confidence, said they had not discussed the ousting of the Bolojan government with the US ambassador. According to The Guardian , US president Donald Trump and Marco Rubio are considering firing Kimberly Guilfoyle following the scandal. Guilfoyle has not addressed the reports directly, although her lawyer has said she did nothing wrong. Guilfoyle is a former Fox News Channel host and California prosecutor who was once engaged to Trump’s son Donald Jr.

data.title: Deloitte: Romania remains among Europe’s cheapest housing markets despite 14% price rise in 2025
data.description: Romania ranked fourth among the European countries with the lowest housing prices in 2025, behind Turkey, Serbia, and Albania, according to Deloitte’s Property Index 2026. The national average reached EUR 1,917 per sqm, up 14.4% year-on-year. This was the largest increase among the countries analysed, followed by Croatia at 14.3%, Slovakia at 12.5%, and Hungary at 10.9%. Prices increased in 19 of the 22 countries for which national data was available. Turkey recorded the lowest average, at EUR 864 per sqm, while Luxembourg was the most expensive, at EUR 9,160 per sqm. “The results highlight a fragmented European residential market, with differences between national markets reflecting the importance of local factors, including housing policies, demographic trends, supply constraints, and broader macroeconomic conditions,” said Irina Dimitriu, partner at Reff & Associates | Deloitte Legal and Real Estate Industry Leader at Deloitte Romania. In Romania, she said price growth was driven mainly by limited housing supply resulting from permitting delays, regulatory restrictions, and higher development costs. Cluj-Napoca remained Romania’s most expensive residential market, with an average price of EUR 3,137 per sqm, up 13.2%. It was followed by Brașov at EUR 2,156 per sqm, up 13.6%, and Bucharest at EUR 2,026 per sqm, an increase of 15.3%. Romania was therefore among the countries where the most expensive city was not the capital, alongside Germany, Italy, and Spain. At European city level, Munich overtook Luxembourg to record the highest average housing price, at EUR 11,200 per sqm. Luxembourg followed with EUR 10,567 per sqm, ahead of Amsterdam at EUR 8,650 and Barcelona at EUR 8,037. On the Romanian rental market, Bucharest registered the highest average monthly rent, at EUR 11.2 per sqm. Cluj-Napoca followed at EUR 10.3, while the average in Brașov stood at EUR 9.3. Marius Vasilescu, advisory partner at Deloitte Romania, said housing transactions declined sharply towards the end of 2025 after more intense activity ahead of the revised VAT rate taking effect. “Despite the decrease in transaction volumes, the average price per square metre continued to rise throughout the period analysed,” he said. “This trend could continue, albeit at a more moderate pace, as supply remains limited in large cities.” The Deloitte Property Index examined residential market developments in 25 countries and 71 cities during 2025. All prices included in the analysis are converted into euros to ensure comparable results.

data.title: Romania’s meteorological agency under fire over luxury purchases with public money
data.description: Romania’s interim environment minister Diana Buzoianu published the findings of an inspection carried out at the National Meteorological Administration (ANM) on Friday, October 9, showing purchases of high-end perfumes, dresses, pajamas, handbags, cosmetics, and a luxury bra, all with public money. According to the minister, ANM spent hundreds of thousands of lei on personal items. As a result, Buzoianu called for the resignation of the ANM management and said that the Ministry will file a complaint with the Prosecutor’s Office attached to the High Court of Cassation and Justice. “What do a luxury bra costing more than RON 1,000, perfumes, dresses, pajamas, handbags, cosmetics, scented candles, high-heeled shoes, fringed footwear, clothes from luxury brands and decorative flower pots costing thousands of lei each have in common? They were all purchased using the official card of the National Meteorological Administration, from the institution’s budget,” Diana Buzoianu wrote on social media, attaching images of models of goods purchased using these cards. According to the minister, in 2025, the following items were purchased using funds from the ANM account: bodysuits, trousers, socks, leggings, underwear, pajamas and luxury accessories worth a total of RON 85,290; perfumes worth a total of RON 119,750; cosmetics worth a total of RON 11,666; room fresheners worth RON 38,687; and decorations and accessories for rooms, bathrooms and kitchens worth a total of RON 30,052. https://www.facebook.com/DianaBuzoianu/posts/1731606402304507?ref=embed_post Among the purchases allegedly made by the ANM last year were also three smartwatches and accessories worth a total of RON 11,545, as well as two floral arrangements worth a total of RON 9,350 (RON 6,000 + RON 3,350). Two decorative flower pots worth a total of RON 6,381 were also purchased. Purchases continued in 2026, according to the minister, with clothing items and luxury accessories worth a total of RON 103,143, perfumes worth a total of RON 12,619; cosmetics worth a total of RON 14,216; and room fresheners worth RON 4,311. “We received several complaints that formed the basis of the request to carry out this inspection at the ANM, but I could never have imagined that such absurdities and such a mockery of public money could be uncovered by any inspection. Under these circumstances, given that these findings represent only a small part of what the inspection team discovered, in any normal state, the ANM management should resign today,” the environment minister concluded. On Sunday, October 11, the minister further revealed that ANM made direct purchases worth millions of lei over the past four years that allegedly violated the law. The purchases included contracts awarded without competitive bidding for toner cartridges, laptops and furniture, with values far exceeding the RON 270,000 threshold below which direct procurement is permitted. The minister identified two companies that were the main beneficiaries of such contracts. Diana Buzoianu also suggested that Elena Mateescu had the support of the Social Democratic Party (PSD), opponents of the reformist Save Romania Union (USR), of which she is a part. “I am curious to see how PSD influencers will explain today why the ANM director should remain in office when, evidently, the law has been optional to apply at the ANM in recent years under Ms. Mateescu’s leadership,” Buzoianu further stated. Buzoianu said she expected the resignations by Monday, October 12. In reply, the director of the National Meteorological Administration (ANM), Elena Mateescu, said she had no direct involvement in the unjustified spending made using the institution’s card. The director ordered an audit to settle the matter and said that a “campaign” had been unleashed to remove her from office. “As director general, I have no direct involvement in the matters thrown into the public arena concerning me and my colleagues who carry out their work at the ANM. At this moment, an unfair and unjustified stigma is being placed on the institution and the colleagues who work at the ANM,” Elena Mateescu said in a public statement issued on Sunday, October 11. The head of ANM claimed that she did not use the institutional card, which was declared “inactive from the moment it was issued.” She also said that she never approved purchases of clothes, perfumes, footwear or cosmetics.

data.title: Romania launches platform for reporting racist incidents
data.description: The Romanian government announced that it launched the Stop Racism platform, an online service designed to facilitate the reporting of hate-related incidents. The platform became operational last week, on October 8. Citizens can submit reports through a structured form on stoprasism.ro without creating a permanent user account. Based on the information provided, the system automatically sends the report to the authority considered competent to handle it. According to the government, if the case falls outside that institution’s jurisdiction, the report can be redirected to another authority, with an explanation provided for the decision. Users can subsequently track the status of their reports through a two-step verification system. The platform also provides information about applicable legislation, victims’ rights, and official studies and reports. It includes further resources such as international documents and details about grants and non-repayable funding opportunities. The government stressed that the service does not replace existing legal procedures or emergency-reporting channels. Anyone facing an emergency should continue to call the 112 emergency number. The authorities also plan to use anonymised information gathered through the platform to improve statistics on antisemitic, anti-Roma, and xenophobic incidents and develop more effective prevention policies. The platform was developed by Romania’s National Institute for Research and Development in Informatics in cooperation with public institutions including the National Council for Combating Discrimination, the Ombudsman, the Interior Ministry, prosecutors, and the Justice Ministry. Its launch is part of Romania’s 2024-2027 national strategy for preventing and combating antisemitism, xenophobia, radicalisation, and hate speech.

It includes further resources such as international documents and details about grants and non-repayable funding opportunities. The government stressed that the service does not replace existing legal procedures or emergency-reporting channels. Anyone facing an emergency should continue to call the 112 emergency number. The authorities also plan to use anonymised information gathered through the platform to improve statistics on antisemitic, anti-Roma, and xenophobic incidents and develop more effective prevention policies. The platform was developed by Romania’s National Institute for Research and Development in Informatics in cooperation with public institutions including the National Council for Combating Discrimination, the Ombudsman, the Interior Ministry, prosecutors, and the Justice Ministry. Its launch is part of Romania’s 2024-2027 national strategy for preventing and combating antisemitism, xenophobia, radicalisation, and hate speech.

data.title: Parapet, MetaWealth start construction of 100 MWh battery project in Romania
data.description: Renewable energy contractor Parapet and investment platform MetaWealth have started building a 50 MW/100 MWh battery energy storage system in Dumbrava-Deal, Neamț county. Civil works have begun, while equipment deliveries are underway, the companies said. The project will comprise 20 battery storage units and five power conversion system units. It also includes a new 20/110 kV high-voltage substation fitted with a 63 MVA transformer. The power conversion equipment is currently being transported by sea, with full commissioning targeted for spring 2027, according to the official announcement. “As solar and wind capacity continues to grow, the ability to store energy generated during periods of surplus and use it later is becoming essential both for balancing the power system and for making more efficient use of renewable energy,” said Paul Moldovan, founder of Parapet. He added that the project reflects the market’s shift from generation-only facilities towards integrated systems combining renewable production, storage, and grid infrastructure. MetaWealth entered the energy infrastructure sector in 2025 and is targeting a combined storage capacity of 200 MWh through its first two projects. “We saw the opportunity in Romania and, once we looked deeper, identified the gap in energy storage,” said Michael Topolinski III, founder and CEO of MetaWealth. “We expect to achieve full commissioning of BESS 1 in spring 2027.” Parapet is currently implementing battery storage projects with a combined capacity of 514 MWh across three Romanian counties. The company said it has installed more than 2 GW of renewable energy capacity across 15 European countries.

data.title: Romanian director Cristian Mungiu’s ‘Fjord’ scores strong North American debut after small-scale release
data.description: “Fjord,” Cristian Mungiu's movie, made the strongest debut at the North American box office, earning USD 124,000 from just four cinemas in New York and Los Angeles, according to News.ro . The movie is a legal thriller about two parents (Sebastian Stan and Renate Reinsve) suspected of child abuse. The film directed by Chris Rock, “Misty Green,” Alex Gibney’s incisive documentary about Elon Musk, “Musk,” and “Fjord,” Neon’s Palme d’Or-winning production, were among the new releases in the specialty box office market. The commercial appeal of all three films, which hope to enter the Oscar race , will be put to the test with their nationwide releases in the coming weeks. “Fjord” starts when Lisbet, a Christian woman who lives with her husband in a small Norwegian town, receives an unexpected visit from local officials who suspect the couple of abusing their children. She realizes that the visitors intend to take their children away before the investigation even begins. The movie is filmed in what The New York Times said is characteristic of Mungiu, in long takes and no close-ups. “Fjord” also leaves viewers to judge for themselves who is the victim and who is the aggressor. This, the same source added, is the essence of the movie. By comparison, “Other Mommy,” a horror film featuring Jessica Chastain, collected USD 27.5 million on its box office debut, beating the other new release this weekend, “The Social Reckoning,” which ranked only fifth, with revenue of just USD 5.5 million. The R-rated film, written and directed by Aaron Sorkin, was expected to earn USD 7–8 million on its opening weekend. Meanwhile, “Digger” recorded a sharp decline in its second weekend, earning USD 3.2 million from 3,321 cinemas, a 60% drop from its disappointing USD 8 million debut. To date, the Tom Cruise satire has barely collected USD 14 million domestically and USD 35.3 million worldwide. Warner Bros. spent more than USD 160 million producing the film. Second place went to “Verity,” which earned $11.4 million from 3,572 cinemas, representing a sharp 64% drop from its opening weekend. “Resident Evil” dropped to third place, earning USD 8.3 million in its fourth weekend of release. “Heart of the Beast,” a wilderness adventure thriller about a man who survives a plane crash alongside his dog, ranked fourth, earning USD 7.1 million from 3,365 cinemas in its third week of release.

data.title: Flamingos filmed on Romania’s Lake Techirghiol
data.description: The first flamingos were observed in the Techirghiol area in 2016, when their presence was considered a rarity, News.ro reported. Larger flocks have since been recorded annually at both Lake Techirghiol and Lake Sinoe. Ornithologist Attila Marton told the local media that many of the birds are young, raising the possibility that some may have hatched in isolated areas of Romania. However, they could also have come from neighbouring Bulgaria or from parts of Ukraine away from the war. “We do not know where they come from, but there are certainly significant numbers every year,” Marton told local publication Ziua de Constanța , as reported by News.ro. “I believe it is only a matter of time before they become a resident, breeding population that can be observed throughout the year in Romania,” he added. https://www.facebook.com/reel/2189344121993251

data.title: Romanian prosecutors indict alleged financier of Călin Georgescu’s TikTok campaign for voter bribery
data.description: Bogdan Peșchir, described by prosecutors as a financier of Călin Georgescu’s TikTok campaign, has been indicted on charges of voter bribery. He will remain free pending trial, and the case has been sent to the Brașov Court, local news agency Agerpres reported. The General Prosecutor’s Office accused Peșchir of 874 individual acts committed as part of a continued offence between October 13 and November 27, 2024. According to the indictment, Bogdan Peșchir allegedly provided benefits worth a total of USD 290,225 to persuade voters to support Russia-friendly independent candidate Călin Georgescu in the 2024 presidential election. The prosecutors said the sum included 868 virtual gifts worth USD 251,065 sent to 105 TikTok users and six cryptocurrency transfers totalling USD 39,160 to two people. The alleged influence operation involved recruiting popular content creators, systematically paying them to promote Georgescu and rewarding both declared supporters and potential voters during TikTok livestreams. “The defendant decisively influenced the topics being discussed, implicitly but unequivocally directing voters to express their electoral preference for this candidate,” the prosecutors said. According to the prosecution, Bogdan Peșchir used significant financial resources during livestreaming sessions, distributing them directly and through content creators as virtual gifts and cryptocurrency. Some TikTok users allegedly came to believe they would receive gifts from Peșchir if they voted for Călin Georgescu. Moreover, the prosecutors also alleged that money was transferred directly to people who agreed to express their support for Georgescu and persuade others within their personal networks to do the same. “Each influencer received RON 390 for 20,000 users,” the General Prosecutor’s Office said. “Through their actions, expressed as general calls to vote during livestreaming sessions, these influence vectors mechanically helped the defendant achieve his objective of bribing voters.” Bogdan Peșchir’s name also appeared in intelligence documents presented to Romania’s Supreme Council for National Defence before the Constitutional Court annulled the presidential election in December 2024 . The Romanian Intelligence Service said Peșchir operated the TikTok account “bogpr” and made donations exceeding EUR 1 million to support Cǎlin Georgescu’s campaign. TikTok reportedly confirmed the account holder’s identity and said the account had made USD 381,000 in payments to users involved in promoting Georgescu between October 24 and November 24, including after the official campaign period ended, Agerpres noted. The indictment represents the prosecution’s allegations, and Bogdan Peșchir is presumed innocent unless found guilty by a final court ruling.

data.title: Inspire Asset Management takes stake in Romanian seaside entertainment project NIBIRU
data.description: Inspire Asset Management recently acquired a stake in NIBIRU Real Estate, the company developing the NIBIRU entertainment and leisure destination on Romania’s Black Sea coast, News.ro reported. The size of the stake and the value of the transaction were not disclosed. The investment firm had already backed NIBIRU during its development phase, and the companies described the move as the continuation of a long-term partnership. “I believe strongly in Romanian entrepreneurship, and I want to continue investing in Romania in companies and projects that have the ambition to build at scale and create value here,” Iulian Stanciu said. “NIBIRU is an ecosystem: dozens of entrepreneurs and operators have already grown around it in a single season, and every new development stage can create more opportunities for them.” NIBIRU representatives said the new entertainment destination recorded more than two million visits during its first season. Together with the nearby Beach, Please! festival, the ecosystem developed in the area exceeded 2.6 million visits. Some operators in the hospitality, food, retail, services, and entertainment sectors generated more than EUR 1 million in sales during the season, NIBIRU said. Andrei Șelaru, known as Selly and the CEO of NIBIRU, said Inspire Asset Management had invested in the project before its first season and that its entry into the shareholder structure formalised an existing relationship. “The first season showed us that there is an audience, there is demand and there is room for something much larger,” Șelaru said. “Our objective is to build on what we have achieved each year and transform NIBIRU into a Romanian project with regional relevance.” The project’s plans for the 2027 season include expanding its infrastructure, developing additional commercial and entertainment concepts, introducing new visitor experiences, and improving services. Iulian Portasă, CEO of Inspire Asset Management, said the investment company would contribute more than capital. “Our role in the next stage is to bring investment experience, know-how and governance to support the acceleration of the project’s development and increase its long-term impact,” he said. https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=122179616228966270&set=a.122134489562966270

data.title: Romania’s PM-designate Luca Niculescu plans to submit government team and strategy this week
data.description: Niculescu has already met representatives of the Social Democrats (PSD), Liberals (PNL) and Hungarian party UDMR last week. PSD argued for reviving the coalition it left in April before bringing down the government in May, while the Liberals rejected the unexpected invitation. Niculescu nevertheless described the talks as constructive. “Yesterday [October 8] we held discussions with parties. The discussions were constructive, substantial and will continue in the coming days. Another round of discussions is scheduled for Monday [October 12] and, obviously, we will most likely draw conclusions on Thursday [October 15], when I intend to submit the government programme and the list of ministers,” Niculescu said in a Digi24 interview on Friday, October 9, as reported by Agerpres . The first major decision of the week is expected on Monday, when PSD’s National Permanent Bureau is scheduled to meet at 10:30 at the party’s headquarters to assess the results of last week’s discussions with Niculescu and decide whether to support a technocratic government. The party led by Sorin Grindeanu insists on a parliamentary majority that would also include PNL and UDMR, but wants the government to pursue an economic programme based on PSD’s priorities. The Social Democrats are calling for a “change in economic direction”, an end to what they describe as “unnecessary austerity”, and measures to stimulate economic growth, while maintaining that Romania’s fiscal commitments must be respected. The Liberals, by contrast, favour continuing reforms in public administration and state-owned enterprises, in line with the governing strategy agreed by four centrist parties, including PSD, in June 2025. PNL continues to back Siegfried Mureșan, the prime-ministerial candidate of the PNL-USR-UDMR grouping who failed to secure the necessary parliamentary support. PNL has ruled out returning to the previous coalition, but has indicated that it could initially vote to invest a minority government formed around the Social Democrats.

data.title: Romania raises some EUR 3.7 bln through private placements this year
data.description: The Treasury raised the equivalent of EUR 1.9 billion on international markets through six such transactions, while domestic private placements brought in RON 9.4 billion through eight transactions, according to Cursdeguvernare.ro . At this scale, the private placements have served as an emergency financing tool for the Treasury amid international market turbulence linked to the US-Iran conflict and the war, as well as Romania’s prolonged political crisis following the breakup of the pro-European governing coalition. The crisis escalated after the Social Democratic Party (PSD) joined AUR in tabling and voting for a motion of no confidence that brought down the Ilie Bolojan government. The Finance Ministry’s latest private placements took place at the end of July. This year, the Ministry of Finance has borrowed more heavily from the domestic market. The prolonged political crisis has narrowed the window for Romania to return to international markets with Eurobond issues under favourable conditions. The Treasury is waiting for a new government to be formed before deciding on another international bond issue, Ștefan Nanu, head of the Treasury at the Finance Ministry, said last month at a JPMorgan conference in London, according to sources cited by Bloomberg. Romania has so far raised EUR 4.7 billion on international markets through euro- and dollar-denominated bond issues. Nanu also told the London conference that the Finance Ministry would probably reduce its planned foreign-market borrowing for this year from the initial EUR 10 billion and would not launch another Eurobond issue until the domestic political situation was clarified, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: Romania’s Cernavoda nuclear power plant faces critical cooling-water constraint as Danube nears operational limit
data.description: According to Mediafax , citing Romania’s National Administration “Romanian Waters” (Apele Române, ANAR), the water level at Cernavoda reached -259 cm, just 3 cm above the operational limit of -262 cm. Falling below this threshold would affect the conditions required to pump cooling water for the plant. The Danube’s flow at the point where it enters Romania has fallen below 1,200 cubic metres per second, roughly one-third of the multi-year average for this period, ANAR said in a statement on Saturday, October 10. Supplementary water discharge in the Danube was already ordered. To limit the further decline in water levels around Cernavoda, ANAR ordered a temporary increase of 20 cubic metres per second in the flow released from the Iezer reservoir between October 10 and 18, through the coordinated operation of reservoirs in the Mostiștea valley. The intervention is being coordinated with controlled releases from the Izbiceni reservoirs on the Olt River and Mihăilești on the Argeș River. The aim is to increase the water reaching the Danube and limit the fall in levels in the Cernavoda sector. “Under current conditions, ensuring the water resources necessary for the safe operation of the Cernavodă NPP represents a responsibility of national interest,” ANAR said. More measures are being considered if water levels fall further. Separately, Romania’s National Committee for Emergency Situations (CNSU) drafted an emergency decision on October 10 proposing a more extensive intervention to secure the water supply to Cernavoda, according to Profit.ro . The draft, which had not yet been adopted, envisages a temporary, modular barrier made from ballasted barges and pontoons across a section of approximately 170 metres of the canal supplying the plant, alongside high-capacity pumping systems. The pumps would be designed to transfer at least 6.5 cubic metres of water per second into the plant’s water-distribution basin. Their deployment would involve Apele Române, Nuclearelectrica, the General Inspectorate for Emergency Situations and the National Company for the Administration of Navigable Canals. The draft sets a water-level threshold of 1.58 metres above the Black Sea datum (dMB) as a preventive trigger for mobilising hydraulic and logistical measures. It explicitly states that this threshold would not change the plant’s authorised operating limits, operating conditions or nuclear-safety requirements. The proposed intervention would remain in place until forecasts indicate a sustained recovery in water levels, measurements confirm that the plant has moved out of the critical range, and natural inflows and reservoir-management measures can maintain the water supply without pumping. Nuclearelectrica said both reactors remain in a safe shutdown state and that the situation poses no risk to nuclear safety. The plant has multiple cooling systems designed to operate at different cooling-water levels. The measures taken by the authorities are intended to preserve redundancy in the cooling systems, particularly by protecting the pumps. Energy Ministry Secretary of State Cristian Bușoi said on October 6 that the two reactors would not be restarted within the following ten days. Unit 1 was shut down in a controlled manner on July 28, while Unit 2 was shut down on August 13, amid severe drought and exceptionally low Danube levels.

data.title: Romania’s SMR project with NuScale hits deadlock as 80% of conditions are not met
data.description: This implies that the project as it was planned can not continue; the company said that it will reassess the SMR technologies and decide accordingly. It concluded that there currently exist premises for the initiation of steps to update the SMR Implementation Strategy in Romania, “for which we continue to appreciate the openness of the American partners." The revised strategy will consider, among other things, an assessment of the most advanced US-origin SMR technologies, a process for matching technologies to the characteristics of the Doicești site, and the potential development of other types of electricity generation capacity. The reassessment does not mean that the current scenario, based on NuScale technology, has been ruled out. Instead, SNN intends to benchmark multiple technologies and scenarios against recent technological developments and their maturity, seeking the most advantageous solution for Romania and to protect the interests of the Romanian state if no positive outcome is reached through the current process. Once the reassessment is complete, an updated strategy will be submitted to SNN’s competent corporate bodies for approval. The process will be conducted in accordance with the intergovernmental agreement (IGA) between Romania and the US, ratified under Law No. 200/2021, and the institutional cooperation established under that agreement. “In parallel, SNN's executive management will conduct an analysis to identify the factors that led to the current situation, respectively the measures necessary to reduce/eliminate, as much as possible, the risks and reduce the financial impact generated on SNN by this Project", SNN also indicated. The three main conditions that remain unfulfilled SNN identified three conditions in the agreement that it considers unmet. A framework agreement between SNN and NuScale. The two parties have not agreed on a final form of the agreement. SNN attributes the delays to NuScale, saying the US company “successively, gradually gave up on the binding elements of what was previously expected to be assumed”. NuScale instead proposed granting SNN a subscription right for its shares at a predetermined price. SNN considers this insufficient in the form proposed. A binding commitment to purchase the SMR modules. The FID envisaged two options: purchasing a single module initially and deciding on the remaining five later, or committing to all six modules while requiring NuScale to reimburse the cost of five if the first module failed to meet performance requirements. According to SNN, NuScale refused to sign a binding agreement covering either option. The natural-gas issue at the site. The third condition concerns natural gas emerging from an old well at the SMR site. SNN says the lack of institutional support affected RoPower Nuclear’s (RPN) ability to meet this condition. An independent study is expected to deliver preliminary results in March 2027 and a final version in October 2027. Responsibility for the steps required to resolve this issue lies mainly with the Romanian side.

data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. Domingos Simões Pereira é um manipulador, um verdadeiro chantagista e calculista provavelmente, tipo de comportamento que ultrapassa o nível de psicopata. U m ambicioso desmedido, um verdadeiro criminoso que sabe como e quando cometer o crime. Ele jamais coabitaria não só com JOMAV, assim como com qualquer presidente que seria eleito, a não ser o que ele apoiou disfarçadamente. Isto porque ele tem sua própria agenda, e o PAIGC é simplesmente uma plataforma para sua concretização. DSP jamais coabitaria com JOMAV porque o seu candidato preferido era o Paulo Gomes e sempre será, o qual juntamente com Tchitchi vão delineando mecanismo de modo a serem os novos donos da Guiné-Bissau. Segundo eles este é um processo a médio prazo, e é preciso coragem e paciência para concretiza-lo. Ganhar o congresso não importa em que circunstância e ter novamente o partido na mão, é uma fase concluída em proveito deles, enquanto verdadeiros militantes do PAIGC estão a bater palmas. Depois dessa eleição legislativa, não importa o resultado, o Cipriano Cassama que se prepare a mala ou fica de bico fechado, pois o candidato preferido para o partido será o Paulo Gomes, e esse sim deve ter a voz dentro do partido. DSP é um ambicioso desmedido, nunca teve consideração por ninguém, JOMAV muito menos, o sujeito é um maquiavélico nato, Cipriano Casama será descartado quando menos esperar podes tomar a nota. Guineenses, falar do Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi é falar do MCCI e demais outras organizações e personalidades camufladas no nosso país. Esses dois indivíduos são os principais financiadores do MCCI e demais outras personalidades boca de aluguel na cidade de Bissau. O MCCI, Milícia idealizado por JBV e DSP, agora financiado e dirigido por "futuro triângulo do poder" ou seja, "DSP, Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi", têm 3 principais objectivos: 1º Perturbar a ordem pública em nome da cidadania, difamar e tentar descredibilizar qualquer que seja organizações ou indivíduos não alinhados ao triângulo, de modo a suportar suas caminhadas na busca do poder. 2º Caso se concretize o objectivo do triângulo, o papel da Milícia do MCCI passará a ser de vigilância constante a todos os adversários de modo a garantir falsa paz social e o poder de controlo. 3º Tentar ganhar credibilidade junto das organizações internacionais e regionais, através de suas visitas e actividades de fachada, para quando houver as tais actividades de perturbações de ordem pública, poderem ganhar notoriedade. Mas isso não deve preocupar ninguém, pois estão bem identificados e bem caçados, dentro e fora da Guiné-Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". Para finalizar, gostaria de vos deixar uma reflexão com a seguinte frase: " Domingos Simões Pereira é um perigo grave para o futuro do país ". Isto porque publicar aqui tudo que é necessário para provar ou sustentar a razão dessa frase, só pode agravar ainda mais a paz social que tanto necessitamos. Chega, chega não podemos continuar a viver nessa turbulência vida toda, meus irmãos guineenses, não é saudável, é tóxico, não é justo para um povo que tanto sofreu. António Aly Silva » aaly.silva@gmail.com » aaly_silva@hotmail.com » Tel. (+245) 668 31 13

data.title: APANHA-SE MAIS DEPRESSA UM MENTIROSO QUE UM COXO!
data.description:
DSP através da sua equipa de "Lambe-Botas" está cavando cada vez mais a sua própria cova, adiantando cada vez mais o seu fim. Somente alguns acreditavam que foi ele quem estava por trás do "Progresso Nacional" o blog onde começou toda essa história de Mentiras, Calunias, Difamações, Ameaças e tantos outros agressões tóxicas ao espírito humano, a todos os que não estão do seu lado e cujo o único objectivo, era ser chamado de rei dos réis da Guiné. Comandou o Progresso Nacional assim como Bin Laden comandou a Al-Qaeda e acabou por fracassar. Pensou, repensou e resolveu voltar novamente ainda com mais TERROR e está a comandar o Guiné Puro tentando levar toda a nação ao abismo assim como o ISIS quer levar a humanidade. Camaradas, Guiné Puro assim como o falecido Progresso Nacional é o reflexo do espirito de DSP, alí é possivel ver tudo e quanto o sujeito é baixo. DSP é um hipócrita e um anarquista moderno. "ACHAS QUE AS NOSSAS MARCHAS SÃO RESULTADO DE VENDAS E COMPRAS?!" essa foi uma das frases da recente publicação que mostram por quem e para que fim, é dirigido o Guiné Puro ou melhor o blog do terror como podem ver já a seguir. Demonstraram mais uma vez claramente que o "MCCI" pertence a DPS, pois uma publicação dessa no próprio blog do ganancioso só pode ser das duas uma: "Boca capli elis ou Foronta passanta e dicidi ca sucundi rostu". Camaradas, Domingos Simões Pereira afundou seu próprio barco devido a sua ganância e complexo de superioridade. "I pirigu pa i faladu ba cuma, el i unicu alguim cu bai escola na Guiné" seu ultimo desejo é "afundar com todos, inclusive o PAIGC". __________PARA A VOSSA CONFIRMAÇÃO, AQUI ESTÁ A PUBLICAÇÃO_________ MARCOS GALINA BARBOSA VAI PERCEBER QUE METEU COM GENTE
PERSISTENTE. BÔ DISSAL I NA BIN FASSI PASSSAÇÃO LI. tUDO PUBLICAÇÕES KU I FASSI
I NA RESP+UNDI PAREL. NIN IKANA SEDU DIDIA. NONA VINGAL MANERA KU NÓ PUDI. JÁ
TEMOS ALGUÉM NO AEROPORTO PARA NOS INFOMAR O DIA EM QUE EL CHEGAR. INVENTOU
AGRESSÃO E NESTE MOMENTO ESTÁ EM QUELUZ EM PORTUGAL. FILHO DA PUTA. MENTIROSO
COMO OS TEUS PATRÕES OS SUJOS JOMAV E BRAIMA CAMARÁ. MARCOS GALINA, BU NA
ARREPENDI. PERA BU DJUBI. ACHAS QUE AS NOSSAS MARCHAS SÃO RESULTADO DE VENDAS E
COMPRAS?! VAMOS PROVAR DEPOIS. FIDJU DI BALETA Olá a todos, ainda bem que descobriram
que o Pirata informático- hackec é o Marcos Galina Barbosa, Eng. Informático.
Tentei várias vezes avisar o Ticha Aly Silva mas ele não respondeu e nem deu
importância julgo eu. No tempo da campanha para a liderança do Paigc, este
indivíduo era um fervoroso apoiante do Bá Quecuto no Facebook e a técnica que
usava era o envio de Phishing aos apoiantes do Dsp, recolhia informações
pessoais das pessoas que posteriormente eram expostas no Blog do Doka. Tentou
comigo mas não resultou. Tenham cuidado com este sujeito que está nas mãos de
B. Camara. Outra coisa, gostaria de conhecer a vossa página no Fecebook. Estamos Juntos. AC Nota GP: Até jovens inocentes,
Lesmes, Masta Tito e demais outros, os tais vendidos e comprados foram as tuas
vítimas. teu filho da puta que o bandido de Baciro Djá trouxe para Bissau para funções no aparelho de Estado e dizes que outros recebem favores.
Desde quando é que és mais honesto ou
mais competentes que os outros? Pagas e até pode ser com a tua vida para
perceberes as irresponsabilidades
dos teus actos. Publicada por O

data.title: DSP, UM PERIGO GRAVE PARA FUTURO DO PAÍS
data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio. Documento António Aly Silva » aaly.silva@gmail.com » aaly_silva@hotmail.com » Tel. (+245) 668 31 13

data.title: DSP não respeita os antigos combatentes e sempre usou e abusou desses camaradas. Prova disso é que continuou a governar mesmo já com Carlos Correia como primeiro ministro. Usou até o cadáver de Carmem Perreira para promover sua imagem, pois é sabido que a malograda como sendo antigo combatente e membro do PAIGC o corpo só deveria passar por ANP e sede do partido e nunca na Primatura como aconteceu, e por cima de tudo com indivíduos alí barricados por vontade própria vandalizando instituição do estado o que demonstra uma clara promoção ao anarquismo. Não respeitou nem o Pai da Nação(ALC), nem o PR quanto mais o formalismo de um estado de direito democrático, prova disso mais uma vez, o ganancioso após o PR ter depositado coroas de flores no túmulo de ALC no dia dos heróis nacionais, reuniu os seus "gangs" para o mesmo efeito, conseguiu até mobilizar um dos familiares do Pai da Nação para lhe acompanhar tudo isso para manipular e dividir os guineenses "guineenses ku udjus fitchadu" para os seus intereses obscuros.
